hooks.command: try { $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $json.tool_input.file_path; if (-not $f) { $f = $json.tool_response.filePath }; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f)) { $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($f); $nodeExe = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'; $root = (Get-Location).Path; $eslintBin = Join-Path $root 'node_modules\eslint\bin\eslint.js'; $prettierBin = Join-Path $root 'node_modules\prettier\bin\prettier.cjs'; if ($ext -in '.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx') { if (Test-Path $eslintBin) { & $nodeExe $eslintBin --fix $f 2>$null } }; if ($ext -in '.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.json','.md','.css','.html','.yml','.yaml') { if (Test-Path $prettierBin) { & $nodeExe $prettierBin --write $f 2>$null } } } } catch {}
